confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Belgrade and Balkan price levels; no city-price searches, live listings, or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are more reliable than July accommodation, which is the least certain. Cocktail and wine_glass were set from the local beer relationship (cocktail about 2.25x beer, wine glass about 1.1x beer) because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX figure came from RBA exchange-rate search-result summaries rather than a direct read of the RBA table, so verify the 2026-10-14 observation before formal use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Balkan and Southeast European capitals such as Sofia and Bucharest for restaurant, cafe, and bar levels, with July hostel and hotel anchors set from general knowledge of Belgrade's summer rates. No single exact comparable city was used.
